title: Flow edge
description: Edges read as sentences: <fromId> <type> <toId>. 'A depends_on B' means B is a prerequisite of A. 'A contains B' means B is organizationally inside Task A (never a prerequisite). 'A leads_to B' is sequence / conditional route. Renderers draw depends_on arrows prerequisite -> dependent.

initiativeId.description: Home initiative = initiative of fromId. Cross-initiative edges are allowed only for depends_on and related_to.

prerequisiteGroupId.description: depends_on only: id of a prerequisiteGroups entry on the fromId node.

condition.description: leads_to only, and only from a Decision: route is live when the decision outcome equals optionId.
